body:
I wrote down the time a patrol truck stopped behind the shop and how many names they took off their list. The meat was still cold when they told us to close early.

I wrote the time and the number on a strip of tape before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow; the tape was across the back door by evening.
title: Freezer note in a butcher's hand

body:
The shopkeeper made me bring the parcel through the back. He said the front counter was closed to anyone who had been beyond the roadblock.

A visitor checked the wrapper but never asked what was inside. He took the slip with the customer name and told us both that the parcel was not to be handed out or discussed, and that the name would be kept on his list. He left the parcel on the table.
title: A parcel put aside under orders
